jobs.title: Lower Division Clerk
jobs.description:
(i) Matric
(ii) Minimum Typing Speed of 30 WPM.
(iii) The selected candidate shall have to undertake and qualify 3 weeks Basic IT Training Course (including MS Office) conducted by the NITB within one year.
(iv) Place of posting: Islamabad
